approaches.title: Recursive in-place tree inversion
approaches.summary: Recursively visits each node and swaps its left and right children in place using Rust reference-counted interior mutability. The root is returned after the entire tree is inverted.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implements recursive in-place inversion by taking and swapping each node’s children, then recursively processing both subtrees.
Refactors the same recursive inversion strategy to use `mem::swap` and pass optional node references, improving borrowing semantics and simplifying child access.
